domain_description: Power generation, transmission, distribution, renewable energy, nuclear power, natural gas systems, hydroelectric, energy storage, smart grid, energy trading, demand response, microgrid, hydrogen, and carbon capture systems per NERC, NRC, IEEE, FERC, and IEC standards.
authority_sources: NERC Reliability Standards (CIP, TPL, FAC, MOD)

engines.name: Power Generation Engine
engines.function: Analyze thermal and renewable power generation systems including combined cycle, simple cycle, coal, nuclear, and distributed generation with heat rate optimization and dispatch economics.
doctrine_topics: combined cycle gas turbine plant performance analysis
simple cycle peaker operation and start-up optimization
heat rate optimization and efficiency improvement
generation dispatch economics and merit order
plant capacity factor and availability analysis
emissions compliance (NOx, SO2, CO2, particulate)
cooling water system design and thermal discharge
plant auxiliary power consumption optimization
generation fleet planning and capacity expansion
distributed generation integration and sizing

golden_queries.question: Analyze the economics of converting a 150 MW simple cycle gas turbine to combined cycle by adding an HRSG and steam turbine, calculating the incremental heat rate improvement, capital cost, and payback period at $3.50/MMBtu gas price

engines.name: Transmission Grid Engine
engines.function: Analyze high-voltage transmission systems including power flow, stability, protection, and reliability per NERC standards with contingency analysis and transfer capability assessment.
doctrine_topics: power flow analysis and bus voltage regulation
transient stability analysis and critical clearing time
voltage stability assessment and PV/QV curves
transmission line impedance and thermal rating
N-1 and N-1-1 contingency analysis per NERC TPL
available transfer capability (ATC) calculation
NERC CIP compliance for bulk electric system
FACTS devices and reactive power compensation
transmission planning and expansion studies
high-voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission

golden_queries.question: Perform a transmission planning study for a new 345 kV line connecting a 500 MW wind farm to the grid, including power flow analysis, N-1 contingency assessment, and NERC TPL compliance evaluation

engines.name: Distribution Engine
engines.function: Analyze medium and low-voltage distribution systems including load analysis, voltage regulation, protection coordination, and distributed energy resource integration per IEEE standards.
doctrine_topics: distribution system load analysis and forecasting
voltage regulation (LTC, regulators, capacitor banks)
protection coordination and relay settings
distribution transformer sizing and loading
underground vs overhead distribution design
distribution automation and SCADA integration
power quality analysis (harmonics, sag, swell, flicker)
DER integration impact studies per IEEE 1547
arc flash hazard analysis per IEEE 1584
distribution system reliability metrics (SAIDI, SAIFI, CAIDI)

golden_queries.question: Design a protection coordination study for a 12.47 kV distribution feeder with 3 reclosers, 5 fused laterals, and a 2 MW solar DER interconnection, ensuring proper time-current coordination and DER anti-islanding per IEEE 1547

engines.name: Solar Energy Engine
engines.function: Design and analyze photovoltaic and concentrated solar power systems including resource assessment, system sizing, inverter selection, and financial analysis with degradation modeling.
doctrine_topics: solar resource assessment and irradiance modeling (TMY, POA)
PV system sizing and module selection
inverter selection and DC/AC ratio optimization
string sizing and voltage window analysis
PV system loss analysis (soiling, shading, mismatch, wiring)
tracking system selection (fixed, single-axis, dual-axis)
battery-coupled solar system design
PV degradation modeling and performance warranty
solar project financial analysis (LCOE, IRR, NPV)
interconnection requirements and utility coordination

golden_queries.question: Design a 50 MW AC utility-scale solar PV plant in West Texas, specifying module selection, inverter configuration, DC/AC ratio, tracking type, and calculating year-1 energy production and 25-year LCOE

engines.name: Wind Energy Engine
engines.function: Analyze wind energy systems including wind resource assessment, turbine selection, wind farm layout optimization, grid integration, and energy production estimation per IEC 61400.
doctrine_topics: wind resource assessment and Weibull distribution analysis
wind turbine power curve and capacity factor estimation
wind farm layout optimization and wake effects
turbine selection criteria (rated power, rotor diameter, hub height)
IEC 61400 turbine classification and design requirements
grid integration and reactive power capability
wind energy production estimation (P50, P75, P90)
noise and visual impact assessment
wind farm SCADA and condition monitoring
offshore wind foundation and cable design

golden_queries.question: Evaluate a 200 MW wind farm site with mean wind speed of 8.2 m/s at 80m hub height, selecting appropriate turbine model, optimizing layout for minimum wake losses, and estimating P50 and P90 annual energy production

engines.name: Nuclear Power Engine
engines.function: Analyze nuclear power plant systems including reactor physics, thermal hydraulics, radiation protection, safety systems, and licensing per NRC 10 CFR standards.
doctrine_topics: reactor physics and neutronics (criticality, burnup, reactivity)
thermal hydraulic analysis and DNBR criteria
nuclear fuel cycle and refueling strategy
radiation protection and ALARA principle
emergency core cooling system (ECCS) analysis
probabilistic risk assessment (PRA/PSA) Level 1-3
NRC 10 CFR 50/52 licensing framework
defense-in-depth and safety system redundancy
containment design and source term analysis
small modular reactor (SMR) technology assessment

golden_queries.question: Analyze the safety case for a small modular reactor using passive safety systems, including ECCS performance during a loss-of-coolant accident, defense-in-depth layers, and PRA evaluation per NRC 10 CFR 52

engines.name: Natural Gas Engine
engines.function: Analyze natural gas systems including pipeline design, gas processing, LNG, compression stations, and gas quality management for midstream and downstream operations.
doctrine_topics: natural gas pipeline hydraulics and sizing
gas processing (dehydration, sweetening, NGL recovery)
LNG liquefaction and regasification process design
gas compression station design and optimization
gas measurement and quality specifications (tariff gas)
pipeline integrity management per 49 CFR 192
gas storage (depleted reservoir, salt cavern, LNG)
pipeline SCADA and leak detection systems
gas interchangeability and Wobbe Index
gas market structure and transportation tariffs

golden_queries.question: Design a 24-inch natural gas pipeline for 500 MMSCFD over 100 miles, calculating pressure drop using the Panhandle B equation, specifying compression requirements and determining optimal compressor station spacing

engines.name: Hydroelectric Engine
engines.function: Analyze hydroelectric power systems including dam design, turbine selection, hydrology, environmental impact, and pumped storage for baseload and peaking power applications.
doctrine_topics: hydrological analysis and flow duration curves
hydraulic turbine selection (Pelton, Francis, Kaplan)
turbine performance curves and efficiency
dam design types and selection criteria
penstock sizing and head loss calculations
pumped storage hydroelectric design and economics
environmental impact assessment and fish passage
small and micro hydro system design
FERC licensing process for hydroelectric projects
reservoir operations and flood control integration

golden_queries.question: Select the appropriate turbine type and size for a 50 MW run-of-river hydroelectric project with 60 meters of net head and design flow of 100 cubic meters per second, calculating annual energy production

engines.name: Energy Storage Engine
engines.function: Design and analyze energy storage systems including lithium-ion batteries, flow batteries, compressed air, flywheel, and thermal storage for grid-scale and behind-the-meter applications per NFPA 855.
doctrine_topics: battery energy storage system (BESS) sizing and selection
lithium-ion battery chemistry comparison (NMC, LFP, NCA)
flow battery technology assessment (vanadium, zinc-bromine)
compressed air energy storage (CAES) design
flywheel energy storage applications
thermal energy storage (molten salt, ice, phase change)
BESS degradation modeling and warranty optimization
fire safety and thermal runaway prevention per NFPA 855
energy storage dispatch optimization and revenue stacking
interconnection and grid service requirements

golden_queries.question: Design a 100 MW / 400 MWh grid-scale BESS for a utility providing peak shaving, frequency regulation, and renewable integration, comparing LFP vs NMC chemistry on a 20-year lifecycle cost basis

engines.name: Smart Grid Engine
engines.function: Design and analyze smart grid systems including advanced metering infrastructure, distribution automation, demand response, and grid modernization using IEC 61850 and IEEE 2030 standards.
doctrine_topics: advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) architecture
distribution management system (DMS/ADMS) design
IEC 61850 communication protocol implementation
smart grid cybersecurity per NERC CIP
grid edge computing and IoT integration
volt-VAR optimization (VVO) and conservation voltage reduction
outage management system integration
grid resiliency and self-healing capabilities
smart grid data analytics and load forecasting
IEEE 2030 smart grid interoperability

golden_queries.question: Design a smart grid architecture for a utility serving 500,000 customers, including AMI deployment, ADMS integration, VVO implementation, and cybersecurity framework per NERC CIP, with 5-year implementation roadmap

engines.name: Energy Trading Engine
engines.function: Analyze wholesale electricity markets, power purchase agreements, financial hedging instruments, and energy trading strategies including day-ahead, real-time, and ancillary service markets.
doctrine_topics: wholesale electricity market structure (LMP, nodal pricing)
day-ahead and real-time market participation
ancillary service markets (regulation, reserves, frequency)
power purchase agreement (PPA) structure and valuation
energy financial instruments (futures, options, swaps)
renewable energy certificate (REC) markets
capacity market mechanics and resource adequacy
congestion management and financial transmission rights
FERC market rules and compliance
energy portfolio risk management and hedging

golden_queries.question: Evaluate a 15-year PPA for a 200 MW solar project at $25/MWh fixed, analyzing the buyer's market risk exposure, basis risk between the PPA delivery point and load zone, and optimal hedging strategy for the basis differential

engines.name: Demand Response Engine
engines.function: Design and optimize demand response programs including load curtailment, load shifting, dynamic pricing, and DR aggregation for grid reliability and customer cost reduction per FERC Order 2222.
doctrine_topics: demand response program design and customer segmentation
load curtailment strategies and baseline methodology
dynamic pricing (TOU, CPP, RTP) design and implementation
DR aggregation and virtual power plant concepts
FERC Order 2222 DER market participation
measurement and verification (M&V) for DR
automated demand response (OpenADR) standards
industrial and commercial DR program design
residential DR with smart thermostats and water heaters
DR as grid reliability resource and capacity value

golden_queries.question: Design a 100 MW demand response aggregation program participating in the ERCOT market, specifying customer segmentation, baseline methodology, notification protocols, and settlement process per FERC Order 2222

engines.name: Microgrid Engine
engines.function: Design and analyze microgrid systems including islanding capability, generation-load balancing, control architecture, and resilience assessment for critical infrastructure and remote communities.
doctrine_topics: microgrid architecture and topology design
islanding detection and seamless transition
microgrid control hierarchy (primary, secondary, tertiary)
generation-load balancing and frequency control
microgrid protection scheme design
renewable energy integration in microgrids
energy storage sizing for microgrid applications
microgrid economic optimization and dispatch

IEEE 2030.7 microgrid controller specification

golden_queries.question: Design a microgrid for a military installation with 10 MW peak load, incorporating 5 MW solar, 3 MW diesel backup, and battery storage for 4 hours of islanded operation, specifying control architecture and islanding transition per IEEE 2030.7

engines.name: Hydrogen Engine
engines.function: Analyze hydrogen production, storage, transportation, and utilization systems including electrolysis, steam methane reforming, fuel cells, and hydrogen infrastructure development.
doctrine_topics: hydrogen production methods (green, blue, gray) comparison
PEM and alkaline electrolysis system design
steam methane reforming with carbon capture
hydrogen storage (compressed, liquid, metal hydride, LOHC)
hydrogen pipeline and transportation infrastructure

hydrogen safety and codes (NFPA 2, ASME B31.12)
hydrogen blending in natural gas networks
hydrogen hub and cluster development
hydrogen LCOH and economic viability analysis

golden_queries.question: Design a green hydrogen production facility using 100 MW of dedicated wind power and PEM electrolysis, calculating hydrogen production rate, storage requirements, and levelized cost of hydrogen (LCOH) compared to gray hydrogen from SMR

engines.name: Carbon Capture Engine
engines.function: Analyze carbon capture, utilization, and storage (CCUS) technologies including post-combustion, pre-combustion, direct air capture, and geological storage with economic assessment and 45Q tax credit analysis.
doctrine_topics: post-combustion CO2 capture (amine scrubbing, membrane)
pre-combustion capture and IGCC integration

direct air capture (DAC) technology assessment
